{{Quote|What about New Alderaan? Support Services found you a nice place.''"<br />"''And five months ago some of Zsinj's agents discovered it. We had to evacuate, at least temporarily.|Han Solo and Leia Organa|<ref name="Courtship" />}}
Not long after the [[Battle of Thyferra|end]] of the [[Bacta War]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> a '''battle''' occurred during the [[Hunt for Zsinj]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] when the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] discovered the location of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]]. The planet was evacuated before his forces attacked, and it was at least five months before the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] refugees could reclaim the world.<ref name="Courtship" /> Two days after the battle, Zsinj's forces [[Ambush at Gravan Seven|struck]] at [[Gravan Seven]].<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
